title: checkin_wrong_pin payload, pv 1 (PROPOSED, 27 Sep)
description: Committed private payload of a checkin_wrong_pin event: a wrong PIN was entered at a check-in. It carries no PIN material, only which entry it was. The server tells guardians once per incident, never as duress and never the bank; the phone still shows the same neutral "Try again" (T47). Numeric fields are integers (spec §5). Adding a field is a pv bump.

checkin_id.description: The checkin_id used in this check-in's checkin_opened payload.

attempt.description: 1-based ordinal of this wrong entry on the check-in. Only entries 1-3 are recorded: from the fourth, every entry shows "Checked in" and the outcome is already no_answer at the deadline (T47).
